top_signals.title: Asian Stocks to Rise as Hike Bets Ease, Oil Climbs: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks were poised to open higher after softer US jobs data eased pressure on the Federal Reserve to keep raising interest rates. Brent crude rose as Yemen launched a bid to recapture Houthi-controlled areas.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
